idleLines: The jacket fits the street now. Come and see it in the window any time.

mission.done: By the end it fits the street itself. Rin hangs it in the window as the street's jacket.

introLines.text: Hello! I'm Rin. I press jackets in the tailor's shop, up the row.
One jacket fits nobody who tries it on. Wear it down the street and let the street measure you.

steps.hint: A jacket that fits nobody who tries it on.
steps.label: Talk to Rin

steps.hint: Tap the jacket in the window.
steps.label: Put the jacket on

steps.hint: Walk the street and let the street measure you.
steps.label: Walk Dobuita in it

mission.title: The Jacket That Fits Nobody

contacts.name: Rin

idleLines: The cats are still there. They move when nobody is looking. Probably.
contacts.job: Knows every shop — charges in stories

mission.done: All three found. Haru shows you the harbour steps — and the view nobody photographs.

introLines.text: Three painted cats hide on Dobuita. Find them all.
Find them, and I'll show you the harbour steps — and the view nobody photographs.

steps.hint: Three painted cats hide on Dobuita.
steps.label: Talk to Haru

steps.hint: Another painted cat hides down the street.
steps.label: Find cat 2 of 3

steps.hint: The last cat is near the harbour steps.
steps.label: Find cat 3 of 3

mission.title: Haru's Three Cats

contacts.name: Haru

idleLines: The wall is shorter today. The café is louder. That is how it should be.

mission.done: Nobody on the wall is real — and every promise on it is kept.

introLines.text: Welcome to the harbour café. I keep every promise on my wall.
Three IOUs wait there, from visitors who promised to come back. Deliver one — or leave one of your own.

steps.hint: Three IOUs on her wall, from visitors who promised to come back.
steps.label: Talk to Mrs. Umi

steps.hint: Tap the wall — deliver all three, one tap each.
steps.label: Deliver the IOUs

steps.hint: The wall gets shorter. The café gets louder.
steps.label: Back to the café

mission.title: The Wall of Promises

contacts.name: Mrs. Umi

finds.effect: A jacket button in the gutter, shaped like an anchor. The awnings lift, briefly, like a salute.
finds.label: Anchor button

finds.effect: A shop sign painted over three times. Three names show through; the oldest glows at dusk.
finds.label: Painted-over sign

finds.effect: A tailor's chalk mark, shaped like a fish. Step on it and a painted fish swims a circle round your feet.
finds.label: Chalk fish

future2029: 2029 — a question, in words only. The harbour is quieter. The street is still here. What would you want Dobuita to still be, if the ships stopped coming?
name: Yokosuka — Dobuita

choices: I bought nothing and saw everything.
side.intro: A stray cat sits on the same step every day. Present your day to the cat before continuing.
side.result: The cat approves everyone. Your day is approved.
side.title: The Cat Mayor

subtitle: A working port town: Dobuita street, tailor row, station slope, harbour steps. Painted, present day.

npcs.name: Jin
npcs.job: Sailor on leave, walks down the harbour steps
npcs.line: Down the steps, the harbour smells like home. I never get used to it.

npcs.name: Aiko
npcs.job: Carries a crate of fish to the café
npcs.line: Fish for the café. If the cats get it first, the cats get it.

npcs.name: Mr. Kado
npcs.line: I sit here so the steps remember someone.
